```{r}

    tidyr::fill(Subset, clustering) %>% 
    filter(Subset == "so_filterRNA200mito10.rds") %>% 
    filter(clustering == "RNA_snn_res.0.5") %>% 
    mutate(cluster_ID_name = paste0(cluster, ": ", cluster_ID))
```

```{r}
cell_type_metadata <- get_metadata_from_so(so_full, metadata = "RNA_snn_res.0.5", reduction = NULL) %>%
    mutate(clusters_grouped = cluster_ID_grouped_key[as.character(RNA_snn_res.0.5)]) %>% 
    select(-RNA_snn_res.0.5) %>% 
    column_to_rownames("cell")
so_full <- AddMetaData(so_full, metadata = cell_type_metadata)
```

# Assign clusters

```{r}
cluster_ann_df <- readxl::read_excel(file.path(results_dir, "cluster_annotations.xlsx")) %>% 
    tidyr::fill(Subset, clustering) %>% 
    filter(Subset == "so_filterRNA200mito10_subsetM.rds") %>% 
    filter(clustering == "RNA_snn_res.0.4") %>% 
    mutate(cluster_ID_name = paste0(cluster, ": ", cluster_ID))

cluster_key <-
    cluster_ann_df$cluster_ID_name %>% set_names(cluster_ann_df$cluster)
cluster_grouped_key <-
    cluster_ann_df$cluster_ID_grouped %>% set_names(cluster_ann_df$cluster)

palette_cluster <- cluster_ann_df$color %>% set_names(cluster_ann_df$cluster_ID_name)

cluster_ID_name_ordered <- cluster_ann_df %>% 
    arrange(cluster_ID_grouped) %>% 
    .$cluster_ID_name
```

```{r}
cell_type_metadata <- get_metadata_from_so(so, metadata = "RNA_snn_res.0.4", reduction = NULL) %>%
    mutate(clusters_M = cluster_key[as.character(RNA_snn_res.0.4)]) %>% 
    mutate(clusters_M = factor(clusters_M, levels = cluster_ID_name_ordered)) %>% 
    mutate(general_M_subtypes = cluster_grouped_key[as.character(RNA_snn_res.0.4)]) %>% 
    select(-RNA_snn_res.0.4) %>% 
    column_to_rownames("cell")
so <- AddMetaData(so, metadata = cell_type_metadata)
```

```{r}
cluster_ann_full_df <- readxl::read_excel(file.path(results_dir, "cluster_annotations.xlsx")) %>% 
    tidyr::fill(Subset, clustering) %>% 
    filter(Subset == "so_filterRNA200mito10.rds") %>% 
    mutate(cluster_ID_name = paste0(cluster, ": ", cluster_ID))
get_metadata_from_so(so, metadata = "clusters") %>%
    plot_umap(color_str = "clusters", label = TRUE, pointsize = 1.2) +
    theme(legend.position = "none") + 
    scale_color_manual(values = set_names(cluster_ann_full_df$color, 
                                          paste0(cluster_ann_full_df$cluster, ": ",  
                                                 cluster_ann_full_df$cluster_ID)))
get_metadata_from_so(so, metadata = "clusters_M") %>% 
    plot_umap(color_str = "clusters_M", label = TRUE, pointsize = 1.2, 
              repel_min_segment_length = 0.1) + 
    theme(legend.position = "none")+ 
    scale_color_manual(values = palette_cluster)
```

# Dot plot marker

```{r}
genes <- c(
    "Ccr7", "Fscn1", # Migratory DCs
    "Irf8", "Itgax", "Sirpa", "Flt3", "Xcr1", # Irf8 high DCs
    "Cd209a", "H2-Ab1", # Monocytic DCs
    "Siglech", # pDCs 
    "Adgre1", "Ccl12", "C1qa", "C1qb", # M1/M2b macs
    "Wfdc17", # M2a macs
    "Mmp12", "Arg1", # MDSC
    "Chil3", "Il1b", # Monocyte/Neuts
    "S100a9", "S100a8", # Neutrophils
    "Mki67", "Stmn1" # Proliferating
)

dotplot_df <-
    get_metadata_from_so(so,
                         metadata = "clusters_M",
                         genes = genes,
                         reduction = NULL) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = 3:ncol(.),
                 names_to = "gene",
                 values_to = "expr") %>%
    mutate(clusters_M = factor(clusters_M, levels = rev(cluster_ID_name_ordered))) %>% 
    mutate(gene = factor(gene, levels = genes)) %>% 
    group_by(gene) %>%
    mutate(scaled_expr = as.vector(scale(expr))) %>%
    group_by(clusters_M, gene) %>%
    summarise(mean_scaled_expr = mean(expr)) %>%
    mutate(
        color = palette_cluster[as.character(clusters_M)], 
        name = glue::glue("<i style='color:{color}'>{clusters_M}</i>")
    ) %>% 
    mutate(name = fct_reorder(name, as.integer(clusters_M)))
dotplot_df %>% 
    ggplot() +
    aes(gene, name) +
    geom_point(aes(size = mean_scaled_expr, color = mean_scaled_expr)) + 
    labs(caption = "color and size are scaled mean expression; cell types not shown in any particular order here") + 
    scale_color_viridis(limits = c(NA, 3) ,oob = scales::squish) + 
    remove_spines() + 
    theme(panel.background = element_rect(color = "black"), 
          axis.title = element_blank(), 
          legend.position = "none", 
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5), 
          axis.text.y = ggtext::element_markdown())
```

```{r, fig.asp = 2, fig.width = 3 }
get_metadata_from_so(so) %>% 
    filter(clusters_M != "3: Myeloid/T doublets") %>% 
    calculate_proportion(clusters_M, group) %>% 
    mutate(clusters = factor(clusters_M, levels = cluster_ID_name_ordered)) %>% 
    plot_proportion() + 
    labs(y = "Frequency of Myeloid") +

```


```{r, fig.asp = 1.6, fig.width = 4}
m_prop_df <- get_metadata_from_so(so) %>% 
    filter(general_M_subtypes == "Macs") %>% 
    calculate_proportion(clusters_M, group) %>% 
    mutate(clusters = factor(clusters_M, levels = cluster_ID_name_ordered)) 
m_prop_df %>% 
    plot_proportion() +
```

## Box plots with stats

```{r}
group_mouse_df <-
    get_metadata_from_so(so,
                         metadata = c("mouse", "hash.ID", "seq", "group"),
                         reduction = NULL) %>%
    select(mouse, group, hash.ID, seq) %>% 
    unique()
```

### Proportion of Total Myeloid

```{r}
prop_df <-
    get_metadata_from_so(so,
                         metadata = c("mouse", "seq", "general_M_subtypes", "clusters_M"),
                         reduction = NULL) %>%
    filter(str_detect(clusters_M, "Myeloid.T", negate = T)) %>%
    filter(str_detect(general_M_subtypes, "Other", negate = T)) %>%
    calculate_proportion(general_M_subtypes, mouse) %>%
    left_join(group_mouse_df, by = "mouse")

prop_df %>%
    ggplot() +
    aes(group, prop) +
    geom_boxplot() +
    geom_point() + 
    labs(y = "Proportion of Myeloid cells", 
         caption = "P-values from t tests, removed myeloid/T doublets") +
    stat_compare_means(
        comparisons = prop_df$group %>% unique() %>% combn(m = 2, simplify = F),
        label = "p.signif",
        method = "t.test"
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~ general_M_subtypes, scale = "free_y", ncol = 5) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = ~ c(0, .[2] * 1.1),
                       expand = c(0, 0)) +
    remove_x_spine() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(
        angle = 90,
        hjust = 1,
        vjust = 0.5
    ))
```

# hashID analysis 

```{r}
hto_df <- so@assays$HTO@data %>% 
    as.matrix() %>% t() %>% 
    as_tibble(rownames = "cell")
get_metadata_from_so(so) %>% 
    left_join(hto_df, by = "cell") %>% 
    mutate(doublets = ifelse(clusters_M == "3: Myeloid/T doublets", 
                             "Doublets", "Not doublets")) %>% 
    ggplot() + 
    aes(hashtag1, hashtag2, color = doublets) + 
    geom_density_2d() + 
    facet_wrap(~genotype + treatment) + 
    theme(aspect.ratio = 1) + 
    labs(title = "In Myeloid Subset")
```
